{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the unique values in customer_segment
print("Unique values in customer_segment:", sales['customer_segment'].unique())

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print("Count of customer_age == -1:", (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check if any revenue values are '999999.99' (QA orders)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", len(qa_orders))

# Preview the revenue column
print("First 5 revenue values:", sales['revenue'].head().tolist())"}
